svg.aria-label: Two funnels side by side. Before: three PRs drop into a funnel whose narrow neck is review, and they flow through. With agents: nine PRs drop into the same funnel with the same narrow neck, and a pile of PRs builds up inside it. Out of the bottom of both, merges trickle out at the same rate.
svg.text: AI widened the pipe into review. it didn't widen review
twice the PRs at the same review speed is not an improvement. it's a bigger pile.
